settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Your license plate is prefilled every time you reserve a spot. We use your preferred spot first in a bulk reservation.

lot.bannerOpen: Reservations for {month} are open — you can reserve until {until}.
lot.bannerLockedAdmin: Reservations for {month} are locked. As an admin you can still edit and cancel them.
